name: Certificates
summary: Certania — finds expired certificates month by month over the last 12 months (plus everything older) and those failing in the next 12 months, and tags their assets Cert failure : <Mon>-<DD>-<YYYY>. Expiry timeline, crown jewels, weak crypto and self-signed metrics, Cert Issue tagging by plugin, and an IoT/app cache fingerprinted from certs. Deterministic — no free-form LLM reasoning.

widgets.title: Certificates expiring ≤ 30 days
widgets.note: Not yet expired, but due within 30 days.
widgets.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Expiring ≤ 30 d" FROM certs c WHERE $__certdate(c.not_valid_after) >= date('now') AND $__certdate(c.not_valid_after) < date('now','+30 day') AND $__scope(c.asset_uuid)
widgets.drill: SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(a.hostname,''), a.ip_address) AS host, c.common_name, c.issuer_name, $__certdate(c.not_valid_after) AS expires, c.asset_uuid FROM certs c LEFT JOIN assets a ON a.uuid=c.asset_uuid WHERE $__certdate(c.not_valid_after) >= date('now') AND $__certdate(c.not_valid_after) < date('now','+30 day') AND $__scope(c.asset_uuid) ORDER BY expires

widgets.title: Expired certificates
widgets.note: Certificates past their not-after date that are still being served.
widgets.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Expired" FROM certs c WHERE $__certdate(c.not_valid_after) < date('now') AND $__scope(c.asset_uuid)
widgets.drill: SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(a.hostname,''), a.ip_address) AS host, c.common_name, c.issuer_name, $__certdate(c.not_valid_after) AS expired_on, c.asset_uuid FROM certs c LEFT JOIN assets a ON a.uuid=c.asset_uuid WHERE $__certdate(c.not_valid_after) < date('now') AND $__scope(c.asset_uuid) ORDER BY expired_on DESC

widgets.title: Certificate expiry — next 12 months
widgets.note: How many certificates fall due each month.
widgets.sql: SELECT substr(d,1,7) AS month, COUNT(*) AS certs FROM (SELECT $__certdate(c.not_valid_after) AS d FROM certs c WHERE $__scope(c.asset_uuid)) WHERE d >= date('now','start of month') AND d < date('now','start of month','+12 month') GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

widgets.title: Certificates in scope
widgets.note: Every certificate navi.db holds for these assets.
widgets.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Certificates" FROM certs c WHERE $__scope(c.asset_uuid)

widgets.title: Top certificate issuers
widgets.note: Who issued the certificates you serve (self-signed shows as its own subject).
widgets.sql: SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(c.issuer_name,''),'(unknown)') AS issuer, COUNT(*) AS certs FROM certs c WHERE $__scope(c.asset_uuid) GROUP BY issuer ORDER BY certs DESC LIMIT 12
